target.title: Preview session workspace images and unsupported files
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Current `main` already owns session workspace text viewing and editing. The remaining gap is binary preview behavior: browser-safe images need a bounded inline preview, while unsupported binary files need a clear metadata-only state instead of lossy UTF-8 replacement text.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented and verified with Codex.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Keeps the existing session workspace file owner boundary and adds only optional preview metadata.
- Strictly decodes text, sniffs file content server-side, and base64-encodes only AVIF, GIF, JPEG, PNG, and WebP.
- Preserves the existing 256 KiB read cap and fs-safe path, symlink, and hardlink guards.
- Renders unsupported binaries as metadata without issuing an editable content hash.
- Preserves the current-main OpenClawKit API: `AgentsWorkspaceFile.encoding` remains `AnyCodable`, with a compile-time compatibility test.
- Renders hostile or unusual unsupported filenames literally instead of interpreting them as Markdown.

## User Impact

Users can preview supported session workspace images inline. Unsupported binary files show their path, MIME type, size, and update time without corrupt text. Existing text editing behavior and existing Swift callers remain source-compatible.

## Evidence

Exact proof head: `b0892aa41f9c428fc5bbb3bfc43645239529539d`  
Latest-main base used for the proof: `29a7654b299f395da8716eb326d1b4d27005dc4d`

### Exact-head browser proof

The recorded flow clicks through text, a supported 5,920-byte PNG (below the 256 KiB cap), and an unsupported 4,096-byte BMP fallback. It uses synthetic `/workspace` paths only.

![Exact-head session workspace click-through](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Solvely-Colin/pr-proof-assets/main/openclaw/pr-95956/b0892aa41f/session-workspace-clickthrough.gif)

![Supported 5,920-byte PNG preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Solvely-Colin/pr-proof-assets/main/openclaw/pr-95956/b0892aa41f/05-png-preview.png)

![Unsupported BMP metadata fallback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Solvely-Colin/pr-proof-assets/main/openclaw/pr-95956/b0892aa41f/06-bmp-fallback.png)

Artifact manifest and WebM: [exact-head proof packet](https://github.com/Solvely-Colin/pr-proof-assets/tree/main/openclaw/pr-95956/b0892aa41f)

### Commands and runs

- Direct AWS Crabbox `cbx_c12a8724885d`, run `run_18c64e9a96c4`, pinned to exact head `b0892aa41f`: `pnpm check:architecture`, all three native i18n checks, `pnpm protocol:check`, 68 gateway tests, 24 Control UI tests, `pnpm tsgo:ui`, and focused E2E lint passed.
- The same exact-head run passed 2 Chromium E2Es and collected both WebMs plus the required supported-PNG and unsupported-BMP screenshots.
- The refreshed `OpenClawProtocol` target built, then an existing-caller-shaped `AgentsWorkspaceFile(... encoding: AnyCodable(...))` snippet typechecked against the generated module.
- GitHub CI on the immediately preceding patch-identical refreshed head confirmed the formerly failing `native-i18n` and `check-additional-runtime-topology-architecture` jobs green; CI is rerunning on this exact rebased head.
- Fresh branch autoreview returned no accepted/actionable findings after the filename-literalization fix. The final assertion-only E2E adjustment also passed focused autoreview.
